legal_basis_and_outcome: Under Charter Articles 39 and 41, the Council imposed sanctions on specified commodities against Southern Rhodesia; adopted 16 Dec 1966.
gameplay_interpretation: Model targeted mandatory sanctions with implementation by member states and a sanctions committee; distinguish abstention from veto.

gameplay_interpretation: Model trade/financial restrictions, humanitarian exceptions, monitoring and sanctions-committee enforcement.

gameplay_interpretation: Model delegated multinational force authorization, not a UN-commanded war; include deadline, coalition participation and reporting to the Council.
